cmd.description: A command line interpreted by the carried Brush shell in a dedicated worker. Brush mediates external program names through the exec caveat and paths opened by the shell through fs_read/fs_write. Builtins run inside the worker; carried utilities and delegated descendants inherit the worker's native L3 boundary but do not re-enter every Brush hook. Full shell grammar is available. Inspect the result's enforcement report and sandbox_kind: a native L3 boundary is reported only when it actually engaged.

env.description: Explicit environment imported into the worker. Ambient variables are not inherited, apart from the minimal operating-system variables required to start children on Windows.

cwd.description: Working directory. The directory must be admitted by fs_read and any active native L3 boundary.
